verdict.rationale: Airwallex exposes extensive API coverage (accounts, cards, transfers, FX, batch payouts, bills/expenses, webhooks, scoped keys, sandbox) plus CLI, SDKs, AI developer connectors, and AgentOS for agent-driven actions, indicating a strong API-first design mirroring most UI functions. However, there's no explicit evidence confirming full parity across every UI feature (e.g., account onboarding flows, dashboard-only settings, some card program management UI elements), so full equivalence isn't independently verified. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or audit comparing API vs UI feature coverage, independent confirmation of no UI-only features.
